general.summary: A series of technology outages that began on Nov. 11 spawned a collective freak-out across the US. Breakdowns that knocked out Microsoft Corp. software, snarled air travel and disrupted the work of the National Security Agency prompted consumers to panic-buy emergency supplies as if these were signs of an impending cataclysm. Certainly, cybersecurity experts say, they were a sign of things to come, as old technology increasingly needs to be replaced.
